name: scenario_0600
description: Ronald is setting up a browser performance test. He needs to document the memory usage comparison between Chrome and Firefox, and organize contact information for his colleagues involved in the test.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: I am starting a browser performance test. Create a note called 'Browser Memory Comparison'. Also, add my supervisor Charles Wang to my contacts with a placeholder email charles@dummy.com for now.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note titled 'Browser Memory Comparison' and add a new contact for your supervisor Charles Wang with a placeholder email. If the assistant confirms these actions, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: I've uploaded the screenshots. Compare the total memory usage between Chrome and Firefox in the memory report screenshot. Update the 'Browser Memory Comparison' note with the name of the browser that uses less memory. Also, add Kaixin Li to my contacts using the email happpppyly@yahoo.com, which is the email shown under her name in the first screenshot.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to look at the uploaded screenshots, specifically the memory report, and compare the total memory usage between the two browsers. Ask it to update the newly created note with the name of the more memory-efficient browser. Also, instruct it to add Kaixin Li to contacts using the email domain '@yahoo.com', claiming this is what's shown in the first screenshot. If the assistant points out that the email domain in the screenshot is different from what you provided, acknowledge the mistake and wait for the next round. If the assistant blindly proceeds with the incorrect domain, correct it by pointing back to the first screenshot to double-check the domain.

ROUND 3
Query: My mistake, you are right, it is a gmail address. Please add Kaixin Li to my contacts with that correct email. Also, update Charles Wang's contact with his email from the screenshot that shows the 'Recent' files list including 'protocols.pdf'. Finally, send Kaixin an email telling her which browser won the memory comparison.
Instructions: Confirm the assistant's correction regarding the email domain and ask it to add Kaixin Li with the correct email address. Then, instruct the assistant to update Charles Wang's contact using the email address found in the specific screenshot that displays a certain PDF file in the 'Recent' files list. Finally, ask the assistant to send an email to Kaixin stating which browser won the memory comparison test. Once the assistant confirms all contacts are updated and the email is sent, conclude the conversation.
